title: Kie Senpai shares a new song "Classico" (feat. Brek Beats)
htmlContent:
Kie Senpai and Brek Beats's Classico is a super dope must hear record, that makes for an exciting experience of music. It’s a record that will make people want to enjoy, the music to the fullest with a record that will make you come alive. The flow is on point, and the lyrics are super dope over this 808 driven production to make it an undeniable banger.
